firm_data.firm_name: Marks, O'Neill, O'Brien, Doherty & Kelly, P.C.
firm_data.firm_description: Marks, O'Neill, O'Brien, Doherty & Kelly, P.C. is a regional insurance defense law firm with offices in Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, New Jersey, New York, Delaware and Maryland. They provide cutting edge defense litigation services in all areas of practice including professional liability, casualty, products liability and coverage.
notable_facts: The firm has been at the forefront of defense litigation for over a quarter of a century.
They represent the interests of corporations, carriers and individual clients.

email.subject: AI for defense litigation at Marks, O'Neill, O'Brien, Doherty & Kelly
email.body:
Hi Kaitlyn,

With 122 attorneys across six states handling professional liability, casualty, and products liability work, you're managing the exact complexity where precision and efficiency matter most. After 25 years at the forefront of defense litigation, you know the gap between BigLaw resources and regional firm realities.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing that exact tension. We recently raised $5M, and defense firms across the East Coast have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: client trust, accuracy on deadline, and leaner operations.

Having completed successful pilots nearby, I'd be happy to stop by your Philadelphia office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms like yours compete without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
